request_payload.title: AAV gene therapy for Tay-Sachs disease.

mentions.sentence: Tay-Sachs disease (TSD) is an inherited neurological disorder caused by deficiency of hexosaminidase A (HexA).

candidates.label: Haploinsufficiency (one working copy is not enough)
candidates.summary: One of the two gene copies is lost or inactive, so the cell makes too little of a protein it needs. The remaining copy cannot cover the shortfall.

candidates.label: ETX101 (AAV9-delivered gene therapy for SCN1A Dravet syndrome)
candidates.summary: An AAV9-delivered gene therapy in phase 1/2 for SCN1A-positive Dravet syndrome.

candidates.label: scAAV9.P546.SLC6A1 intrathecal gene replacement
candidates.summary: A virus-delivered extra copy of SLC6A1, given into the spinal fluid, to restore GABA re-uptake. First-in-human trial is open by invitation.

candidates.label: Eliglustat (substrate reduction)
candidates.summary: An oral drug that slows production of the lipid that builds up in Gaucher disease (substrate reduction).

candidates.label: Kv7 potassium channel openers (ezogabine / retigabine, XEN496)
candidates.summary: Drugs that open KCNQ2/KCNQ3 (Kv7) potassium channels, studied in KCNQ2 encephalopathy due to loss-of-function variants.

candidates.label: Quinidine (KCNT1 channel blocker, repurposed)
candidates.summary: An antiarrhythmic drug and partial KCNT1 antagonist tried in KCNT1 gain-of-function epilepsies, with mixed results.

candidates.label: Ganaxolone
candidates.summary: A neuroactive steroid with an FDA label for seizures associated with CDKL5 deficiency disorder.

candidates.label: Sodium channel blocking anti-seizure medicines (class)
candidates.summary: A class of established anti-seizure medicines that reduce sodium channel activity. Published responses differ by gene and by variant mechanism.

mentions.sentence: Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) HexA activity increased from baseline and remained stable in both patients.
